data.title: 早露 · 伯爵旧邸的红茶回音
data.action: 优雅侧卧在红丝绒贵妃榻上，白熊短耳微动，修长白皙的手指轻拈着骨瓷茶匙，温和忧郁的眼眸注视着推门进来的博士。
data.location: 罗德岛私人文学茶沙龙，精致骨瓷茶具与温暖壁炉，窗外是切尔诺伯格旧雪景画像
data.lighting: 壁炉炭火跳跃的金色光泽与高脚立灯柔光交融，在香槟色真丝裙上泛起温润缎光
data.mood: 贵族少女走出阴霾后的优雅从容与成熟韵味，静穆高贵
data.description: 罗德岛私人文学茶沙龙，精致骨瓷茶具与温暖壁炉，窗外是切尔诺伯格旧雪景画像。优雅侧卧在红丝绒贵妃榻上，白熊短耳微动，修长白皙的手指轻拈着骨瓷茶匙，温和忧郁的眼眸注视着推门进来的博士。 她微微抬眸轻语——“乌萨斯的夜晚总是漫长而冰冷……但只要能与博士坐在这里共享一杯红茶，过去的噩梦仿佛也变得遥远了。”
data.promptProse: Rosa reclines on a crimson velvet chaise lounge inside a quiet literary tea salon on a winter night, wearing a pale champagne-gold double-layered silk slip gown with fine golden neckline embroidery. Holding a bone china teacup and silver spoon with poised grace, she welcomes the viewer with a soft smile as fireplace glow warms the room against the frosted glass.
data.animaCaption: Reclining gracefully on a crimson velvet chaise in a champagne-gold embroidered silk slip gown, she fingers a silver spoon beside her bone china teacup and looks gently toward the viewer. Warm hearth firelight glints on the silk against the frosted winter window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pale champagne-gold double-layered sheer silk empire-waist slip gown embroidered with fine gold scrollwork along the neckline.
